summary: 57 units reviewed (54 verses + 3 speaker lines). 11 units need fixes, all minor (13 issues, 0 errors): small additions in translations (unit 14 'him', 20 'as huge as'/'विशाल', 29 'back'/'लौट', 30 '-से', 13 'जाने में'), a wrong nuance (24 'sands of Karambha' for the karmadhāraya karambha-vālukā and 'here and there' for pṛthak; 36 'many' for bahuvidhāḥ; 44 result clause for the relative ye ime; 4 future for sthitam), and two notes to add (21 alternative construal with pretaiḥ of verse 20; 38 epic form abhyajānata). Text flags: unit 42 sā->sa is a sound 'possible' flag (no feminine referent, metre indifferent, sa is the sandhi form of saḥ); unit 52 yāsmyāmi->yāsyāmi is certain (yāsmyāmi is no form; metre 8 syllables fits yāsyāmi); medium confidence on 21, 42, 52 is honest (52 could be high since the correction is certain). Splits, grams and token coverage are sound throughout; no GROUPING changes suggested. Glossary: consistent (dharma, karma = action, O king, O Bhārata, tāta = dear one). Suggested glossary additions for later chunks: devadūta = messenger of the gods (देवदूत); dharmarāja = King of Dharma (धर्मराज); Suyodhana kept as given, not Duryodhana.
